ov: A baleen whale, the largest animal known to have ever existed: up to 30 m long and 200 tonnes. Its long, slender body is blue-grey above and paler below.

why.et: Protected: trading its meat is illegal, though blue–fin hybrid meat has turned up in Japanese markets.

rg: All major oceans, in four subspecies.

cf.tip: Both are baleen rorquals; the blue whale is far longer and slimmer, without the humpback’s long flippers.
